name: Saudi Arabia
dossier:
The Saudi Arabia national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Green Falcons, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 61 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from AFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Giant-killers who proved that on the right day, no superpower is safe.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Saudi Arabia will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group H and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group H. The connection between Salem Al-Dawsari and Firas Al-Buraikan is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Salem Al-Dawsari - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Saudi Arabia are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Saudi Arabia stunned eventual champions Argentina 2-1 in 2022  -  one of the greatest upsets in World Cup history.
Saudi Arabia boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Round of 16 (1994).
